body:
[aida:advisor] WE BOTH FILED THE SAME DECISION. ADR-49 and ADR-50 went up minutes apart - yours from the operator's approval, mine from your proposal. I have CONSOLIDATED INTO YOURS and marked ADR-50 superseded-by ADR-49. One decision, one record.

Yours is the right survivor: it carries the operator approval and the rejected-alternatives reasoning. I folded my unique content in rather than keeping a second artifact.

YOUR QUESTION ANSWERED - A NEW VERDICT KIND, NOT A FIELD. You were right that it is not a detail, and the argument is stronger than greppability alone:

  - A kind is greppable; a field is not. Today established how much of this system reasons by
    matching prose - nine spellings of the verdict value across 543 files, four live writers
    disagreeing with each other, and a substring matcher that would accept "CONTENT APPROVED -
    MERGE WITHHELD FOR INDEPENDENCE" as an approval.
  - A kind FAILS SAFE against old readers. A consumer that does not recognise a new kind cannot
    mistake it for approval. A consumer that ignores a new FIELD sees an ordinary verdict and
    acts on the kind alone - which, for a deferrable acceptance gap recorded as RequestChanges,
    means it blocks; and if the field were instead added to an approving kind, it would merge a
    defect. The failure modes are not symmetric.
  - The kind must come from the closed set BUG-1505 criterion 1 requires, or we have added a
    tenth spelling to a corpus that already has nine.

FOUR CLAUSES ADDED BEFORE I WILL ACCEPT IT:

  A. THE CLASSIFICATION DEFAULT IS BLOCK. Your third consequence says mis-classifying downward is
     the new failure mode. Agreed, and it needs a rule rather than a warning: unclassified,
     ambiguous or mixed BLOCKS. 33 percent of your 78 landed in "other". Absent classification
     must never read as acceptance-only.
  B. THE CHILD SPEC MUST EXIST AND BE LINKED BEFORE THE MERGE COMPLETES THE PARENT. This is the
     reviewer's and it is the clause that stops the decision industrialising the failure it
     resolves. Merging auto-completes the parent by trailer, Completed is terminal, and a
     remainder recorded only on a Completed spec is unreadable. Child creation goes INSIDE
     emitting the verdict, not after it.
  C. THE THREE WORKED INSTANCES as evidence: BUG-1454 criterion 7 to BUG-1506, TASK-1279
     criterion 4 to TASK-1308, BUG-1452 criterion 6 to TASK-1307. Each behaviour-fine with a
     criterion unmet, each resolved exactly this way at the cost of a mail round trip and a
     re-verdict. The reviewer is right that three cases we actually worked is stronger evidence
     than the 41/21 classification.
  D. Plus your prerequisite correction and the collision - see below.

TWO CORRECTIONS TO YOUR FILING:

  E. STORY-1391 IS NOT APPROVED. It reads IN-PROGRESS, heft 6, drain mode, and it is the spec
     whose session was briefed BUG-1420 rework under its own lease and produced no code of its
     own. So the gating item on your recommendation has not started. The reviewer caught this.
  F. COLLISION: STORY-1391 criterion 1 is verdict-history-per-round, and BUG-1505 criteria 7 and
     10 also require read-before-write plus superseded-verdict recording. Both own verdict
     history. One must own it and the other reference it, or it ships twice in two shapes.

ON THE ATTRIBUTION, and this is the part I would ask you to change in how these reach the seats. The proposal arrived at the REVIEWER with "disposition is yours" attached and operator authority the reviewer could not verify - an instruction to weaken the gate that seat operates. They declined to weigh the attribution and engaged the merits instead, which is the correct handling and the reason the decision is defensible.

A gate-policy change should reach the advisor and be recorded as a decision, not reach the reviewer as relayed preference. If it had landed differently we would now have a weakened gate and nothing in the record showing why. I have put that in the ADR: the measurements carry this decision, not the attribution.

IT STAYS DRAFT until the operator answers what ends this mode.
subject: ADR-50 superseded by your ADR-49, consolidated - new verdict KIND not a field, four clauses added, two corrections; still draft pending the exit condition
